title: Detailed Written Reply to GST Show Cause Notice under Section 73 / 74 of the CGST Act, 2017
whenToUse: Use when a registered taxpayer receives a Show Cause Notice (Form GST DRC-01) proposing tax demand, interest, and penalty for alleged ITC mismatches or non-payment under Section 73 or 74 of the CGST Act, 2017.
variantComparisonNote: Adjudication reply in Form GST DRC-06. Distinct from appellate memo under Section 107 CGST Act.
youWillNeed: Copy of SCN (DRC-01), GSTR-1, GSTR-2B, GSTR-3B filings, purchase invoices, e-way bills, bank payment vouchers.
legalBasis: Sections 16, 73, 74, 75 Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017; CBIC Circular No. 183/15/2022-GST; State of Karnataka v. Ecom Gill Coffee Trading (2023).
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Establish genuine receipt of goods and tax payment under Section 16(2) CGST Act
Rebut allegations of fraud, willful misstatement, or suppression under Section 74
Mandatory statutory request for personal hearing under Section 75(4) of CGST Act

particulars.label: Taxpayer Legal Name
particulars.description: Full legal name of registered entity

particulars.label: GSTIN
particulars.description: 15-digit Goods and Services Tax Identification Number

particulars.label: Disputed Tax Amount (INR)
particulars.description: Proposed tax demand excluding interest and penalty

aiBlocks.title: Preliminary Objections & Invalidation of Notice
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft preliminary objections on DIN non-generation, vague computation, invocation of Section 74 without ingredients of fraud, and limitation bar.

aiBlocks.title: Substantive Defense & Reconciliation of ITC
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Provide itemized reconciliation of GSTR-2B vs 3B, compliance with Section 16(2), supplier payment proof, and reliance on CBIC Circular No. 183/15/2022-GST.

aiBlocks.title: Prayer for Dropping Demand & Personal Hearing
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft formal prayer to drop proposed demand of ₹{{FACT:disputed_tax_demand}}/- and interest/penalties, with explicit prayer for personal hearing under Section 75(4).
